title: Do you guys recognize your dream locations or is it a new world?
content: Example; my mall layout is basically modeled after a shopping center a few towns over that I used to frequent in my teens. The airport/train station look just like Denver airport and Union Station. I’ve been to Denver only a couple of times in my life. The school is almost just like one of the high schools I attended (moved around a lot, I went to 3)- large open campus, and a fence around the whole thing. I also frequent an “apartment world” of sorts, but the only apartments I ever go to are actually like…. the places I’ve lived at with a specific ex boyfriend of mine. Bear with me because this is hard to explain, but it’s like I’m in this giant apartment building, but it’s actually his parent’s house that we used to live in? I have no idea. We were together for 5 years and we broke up in 2015, over a decade ago at this point. I have no idea why I dream of these places so frequently to this day.
